speaker: john_heminges
text: Will? John. From the mercer's, in Cheapside, and I'd as soon be out of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What does he say, John? Have we a Princess, or does she come in what we already own?

speaker: john_heminges
text: The Princess of France wants a gown fit for one: watchet taffeta, and copper lace that will pass for gold at ten paces.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What does he name for it?

speaker: john_heminges
text: Fifty shillings. He will take half down. The— the stock has eleven shillings in it till Saturday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Could France be poorer, and still be France?

speaker: john_heminges
text: Not when the King of Navarre goes in his own old velvet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not pay the half. Let him set the fifty against the Queen's twenty pounds, whenever that comes. Nothing from my purse, and nothing out of the eleven today.

speaker: john_heminges
text: He will take the note. The half is not paid. I am not pretending Saturday's stock is a larger stock than it is.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Beside me, being measured, standing like a post. He bids me say the sleeves must be long. He's grown.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Long sleeves, then. God keep you both.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And you, Will. We will be back before the play.
